# Fibery’s AI Connectors enter free beta with creation tools


By OpenTools Team


The editor exposes secrets, errors and code; faster syncing and connector creation through MCP remain prospective.


##


Create and manage


The[announcement](https://community.fibery.io/t/october-29-2026-ai-connectors-are-in-beta-and-free-select-several-blocks-in-rich-text/11470) says AI Connectors now let users see Secrets, Errors and Code in the editor and attach files. Installed connectors appear under Settings → Integrations.


##


Pricing remains undecided


Free pricing applies to the beta. Fibery will monitor usage before a year‑end charging decision; faster syncing is under consideration. Creating connectors through MCP‑enabled coding tools or chats remains planned. Existing MCP whiteboard support is separate.


Original status map: AI Connectors are free in beta; creating them through MCP remains planned. This is not Fibery’s interface.
